prs.title: fix: use Rust for legacy runtime latency quantiles
prs.head: 840fa2e0a26ab60c138747a4309aba5df506edc1
prs.author: jyqj
prs.body_claims:
## Why

The active runtime report still calculated legacy latency quantiles in Python after running the Rust statistics replay. That left two live owners of the same nearest-rank calculation and made the P8-017 cleanup incomplete.

## What changes

- Add a Rust nanosecond wire adapter that calls the existing `nearest_rank` implementation and preserves the original all-terminal-outcome populations, nulls, field names and nanosecond precision.
- Have the Rust replay produce the legacy all/read/build summaries directly from validated `finished_ns - offered_ns` values.
- Remove Python's duplicate quantile function and copy the same verified `statistics.json` bytes after checking their SHA-256 against the replay receipt.
- Add Rust precision, boundary, empty-group and terminal-outcome controls, plus Python active-copy and post-verification tamper controls.
- Update the runtime evidence guide and bind the fixed source review using only the existing v15 pin mechanism.

The candidate starts from main `60e5ce3ccc86f5cccb40f6f9c32bbc7b77bf1e9d` and retains #170's batching changes. The actual product commit is `bbe7a9e77f332448b610c54460b355c5936e8c2a`, with exactly five changed implementation/test/document paths. The complete domain remains 1,089 product inputs and 138 validation inputs.

## Validation

The final five blobs have been independently read and reviewed by multiple agents, including the actual Git diff and source ancestry. Static review caught an intermediate misplaced test assertion; the final test restores the original successful-observation method exactly.

Compilation and the new controls have not yet run at PR creation. The existing CI and path-triggered runtime workflows must validate this exact candidate with their original workloads and limits. Results will be recorded as they become available.

## Task boundary

This addresses one concrete P8-017 implementation gap. The original 192 task definitions, statuses, dependency graph and P8-005 acceptance subgates are unchanged: **163 done / 29 remaining / 0 newly completed TODOs**. P8-017 remains in progress pending its dependencies and full acceptance.

The original E scale study failed before completing all 150 shards and 1,500 samples, and the original Mac regression remains under separate fixed-source diagnosis. Neither older executions nor the isolated Mac diagnostic are relabelled as evidence for this candidate. This PR grants no live-provider, quality-gate or release certification.

Initial execution head: `9a52cd24337294e70281badc861bda7bdf0a9f0a`. Initial independent review commit: `4e4671482333c1762efa9c5ab9aeceadc0f3e295`.

## Formatter follow-up

The first CI run [37894025756](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37894025756) stopped at `cargo fmt --all --check`: its original check log identified two formatting changes in the newly added Rust tests. That failure remains recorded. The MSRV job for the initial head passed; later check steps were skipped after the formatter failure.

Apply exactly those two formatter outputs, with the complete production prefix and all test values/assertions unchanged. The original failure log and an independent before/after review are retained under `artifacts/checkpoints/p8-runtime-statistics-owner-20261009/formatting-followup/`. No formatter, source-integrity or test gate is weakened.

Current product commit: `98173d7bf3a4709d0309907ec85ff5674c23c921`. Current review commit: `13610caf2904f7656fa45ccbf20f61a313b708b8`. Current execution head: `840fa2e0a26ab60c138747a4309aba5df506edc1`.

Seven original pull-request workflows have been observed starting on the current execution head. Their results are pending; no CI pass or additional completed TODO is claimed by this update.

prs.title: Integrate reviewed surface-window and macOS engineering fixes
prs.head: 7b1fc54485bfda1b00f5e316617052900b99fb63
prs.author: jyqj
prs.body_claims:
## Why

#173 and #174 make disjoint engineering changes, but each binds a complete v15 source registry. Combining either old registry with the other PR's source would leave the admitted inputs inconsistent. This PR combines their exact reviewed source changes over fixed main `60e5ce3ccc86f5cccb40f6f9c32bbc7b77bf1e9d` and installs a new complete source binding.

## Changes

- Reuse the bounded public-surface query window only within one prepare call when the final seeds and admission bounds remain valid; preserve the original SQL fallback and epoch fencing.
- Prepare the macOS subprocess test helper before the original 250 ms assertion, and match test-only platform cfg boundaries to their existing callers.
- Preserve all 65 original archive additions from #173/#174 and the original source-specific controls workflow.
- Add an independent review of the actual combined product, then install only the standard schema-10 registry and four immutable v15 pins. Verifier logic, exclusions, historical protections, CI commands, original scale budgets and task definitions are unchanged.

The exact main-to-product scope is five Rust files, 65 new archive files and one retained workflow. PR #175 is outside this fixed candidate.

## Fixed source and review

- Product P: `59c2197ebbada4e8cb2091d2fc7a852aa28c9205`
- Independent review R: `c6c8030d359107c82f0f738d8ef270778b5f887d`
- Execution candidate G: `7b1fc54485bfda1b00f5e316617052900b99fb63`
- Complete product inputs: 1,089; historical delta paths: 44; validation inputs: 139.
- Registry SHA-256: `754442a8ff237eedaebac63aeeb1ae03f4baeb462b2ee1f8d84bada3cb56ee73`.

The [canonical review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/7b1fc54485bfda1b00f5e316617052900b99fb63/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-combined-surface-mac-28fe-20261009/independent-source-review.json) and [detailed review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/blob/7b1fc54485bfda1b00f5e316617052900b99fb63/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-combined-surface-mac-28fe-20261009/independent-review-details.json) bind actual Git contents. Root separately verified that R adds only five review artifacts and G modifies only the two identity files, with unchanged verifier logic.

## Validation and evidence boundary

Both original PRs have passed their own three-job CI. Those results support review of their respective inputs; the combined candidate's original CI has not yet executed at PR creation and must supply its own result. This draft grants no combined runtime, full-scale, platform, quality or release certification.

The old #173 controls workflow keeps its original source guard and branch trigger. It is retained as a validation input and is not reused as a run plan for this combined product.

The A23 scale run `37872522779` ended in failure: its original aggregate reports 146 missing shards after the 100k runner lost communication. All four valid original shards, that failure and the old Mac failure remain historical evidence; none is relabelled for G. A new full study must keep the original five sizes × 30 repetitions, 150 shards and 1,500 composite measurements on its fixed complete source.

prs.title: docs: clarify platform evidence and regression scope
prs.head: 60e635877fdb4cb97f7372e04b6685cf5d50e43e
prs.author: jyqj
prs.body_claims:
## Why

Platform results cover different commands and preconditions. The current guide needs to state that scope explicitly so a cold product build or one successful diagnostic is not read as a complete workspace regression result.

## What changes

- Add a dated platform evidence section to `docs/BENCHMARK.md`, linking the fixed E eight-cell build matrix, original macOS 26.6.2 / Rust 1.95.0 / SDK 15.4 workspace failure, and later hosted macOS 15 diagnostic.
- Record the original unknown SDK field and distinguish fresh-target product builds, workspace regressions, isolated tests, and fresh versus pre-executed helper conditions.
- Add the corresponding source/OS/architecture/toolchain/SDK reporting guidance to `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Review and validation

The author and primary reviewer independently read the original documents and exact two resulting Git blobs. The actual commit `60e635877fdb4cb97f7372e04b6685cf5d50e43e` has only these two documentation changes relative to main `60e5ce3ccc86f5cccb40f6f9c32bbc7b77bf1e9d`. Its product and validation source bytes, workflows, guards and task ledger are identical to that base.

The full original logs of the isolated diagnostic were read and hashed. Its workflow succeeded, while the original diagnostic ZIP still awaits independent intake; this limited result does not resolve the earlier Mac workspace failure. This PR does not claim a fresh formatter/test execution; existing CI must report its own result for this head.

## Task boundary

This addresses a documentation gap for P8-018. Original task definitions and dependencies remain unchanged: **163 / 192 done, 29 remaining, 0 newly completed TODOs**. P8-012 and P8-018 remain open with their original acceptance conditions. No live-provider, G8 or release approval is granted.
